records.issue_text: EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? executes an uncached DB query (where("lower(host) = ?", host).first) on every /embed/comments request, replacing the previously process-cached SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? check, so database load now scales linearly with embedding traffic on the highest-QPS embed route; needs a cached lookup invalidated on admin CRUD or at minimum request-level memoization
